{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column from string to float, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter to only completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter out rows with NaN revenue
df_completed = df_completed.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Compute the mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = df_completed['revenue'].mean()

mean_revenue"}
